{{nihongo|'''Ishizukuri Shrine'''|石作神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

'''Ishizukuri Shrine''' (いしづくりじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Ginan, Gifu|arz|جينان|ceb|Ginan-chō|es|Ginan (Gifu)|fa|گینان، گیفو|fr|Ginan|it|Ginan|ja|岐南町|ko|기난정|ms|Ginan, Gifu|my|ဂင်းနန်မြို့၊ ဂိဖု|pl|Ginan (Gifu)|ru|Гинан|sv|Ginan, Gifu|tl|Ginan, Gfu|tr|Ginan|uk|Ґінан|ur|گینان، گیفو|uz|Ginan (Gifu)|zh|岐南町|qid=Q1204285}}, {{ill|Hashima District, Gifu|ceb|Hashima-gun|es|Distrito de Hashima (Gifu)|fa|شهرستان هاشیما، گیفو|fr|District de Hashima|id|Distrik Hashima, Gifu|it|Distretto di Hashima|ja|羽島郡|ko|하시마군|pl|Powiat Hashima|pt|Distrito de Hashima|uk|Повіт Хасіма|vi|Hashima (quận)|zh|羽島郡|qid=Q615068}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} identified with “Ishizukuri Shrine” in Haguri District, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}}, from the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}''.

=== History ===
Until the {{ill|Edo period|lt=Edo period|qid=Q184963}}, it was called '''Ishizukuri Daimyōjin''' and was the {{ill|Ujigami|Q767655|qid=Q767655}} of Kise (a branch hamlet of Miyake Village, {{ill|Haguri district|Q11610214|qid=Q11610214}}). According to shrine tradition, it was founded in {{ill|Jōwa (Heian period)|Q1075605|qid=Q1075605|lt=Jōwa}} 6 ({{ill|839|ab|839|af|839|als|839|am|839 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|839|ar|839|ary|839|ast|839|avk|839|az|839|azb|۸۳۹ (میلادی)|bcl|839|be|839|be_x_old|839|bg|839|bn|৮৩৯|bpy|মারি ৮৩৯|br|839|bs|839.|ca|839|cdo|839 nièng|ceb|839|ckb|٨٣٩|crh|839|cs|839|csb|839|cv|839|cy|839|da|839|de|839|el|839|eml|839|eo|839|es|839|et|839|eu|839|fa|۸۳۹ (میلادی)|fi|839|fo|839|fr|839|frr|839|fy|839|ga|839|gan|839年|gd|839|gl|839|he|839|hi|839|hr|839.|ht|839 (almanak jilyen)|hu|839|hy|839|id|839|ilo|839|io|839|it|839|ja|839年|jv|839|ka|839|kaa|839|kk|839 жыл|ko|839년|la|839|lb|839|lij|839|lmo|839|lt|839 m.|lv|839. gads|map_bms|839|mdf|839|mg|839|mhr|839|mk|839|mr|इ.स. ८३९|mrj|839 и|ms|839|mzn|۸۳۹|nah|839|nap|839|nds|839|new|सन् ८३९|nl|839|nn|839|no|839|nrm|839|nso|839|oc|839|or|୮୩୯|os|839-æм аз|pl|839|pnb|839|pt|839|qu|839|ro|839|ru|839 год|rue|839|sa|८३९|scn|839|sd|839ع|se|839|sh|839.|shn|839|si|839|simple|839|sk|839|sl|839|smn|839|sq|839|sr|839|su|839|sv|839|sw|839|tg|Соли 839|th|พ.ศ. 1382|tk|839|tl|839|tly|839|tr|839|tt|839 ел|uk|839|ur|839ء|uz|839|vec|839|vi|839|vls|839|war|839|wuu|839年|xmf|839|zh|839年|zh_min_nan|839 nî|zh_yue|839年|qid=Q23874}}). Since early modern times this area has belonged to {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}}, but it is said that before the {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} era it was in Haguri District of Owari Province, and the shrine is identified with “Ishizukuri Shrine” of Haguri District in the ''Engishiki Jinmyōchō''. There is little dissent from this identification, and {{ill|Tsuda Masanari|Q22123474|qid=Q22123474}} also supports it{{Sfn|Tsuda Masao|1978|p=58}}. For divine rank, the Atsuta manuscript of the ''{{ill|Owari Kokunai Jinmyōchō|Q11041830|qid=Q11041830}}'' has “Junior Third Rank Upper, Ishizukuri Tenjin,” while the Kōnomiya manuscript has “Senior Fourth Rank Lower, Ishizukuri Tenjin.”

Proceeds were used to rebuild shrine buildings and improve the grounds.

=== Enshrined deity ===
; Takemarine-no-Mikoto
:Takemarine-no-Mikoto is said to be a sixth-generation descendant of {{ill|Amenohoakari|Q10940411|qid=Q10940411}}, grandson of {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602}}. He is said to have made and presented the stone coffin of Empress {{ill|Hibasu-hime|Q8375821|qid=Q8375821}}, consort of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|Q314850|qid=Q314850}}.
